Ordinary scans resolve all 13 channel uploads playlists with channels.list and fetch playlistItems.list pages. Each page holds 50 videos; stop on no nextPageToken or an entirely older-than-six-days page, with ten pages maximum per channel.
Normalize video IDs, owners and original publication dates. Keep recent UFC prediction/pick/breakdown titles; reject excluded formats and ambiguous or other-event titles.
Skip previously recorded videos; permit RETRY_LATER below three attempts after a five-hour gap. Process at most ten selected videos per run, with new videos ahead of retries.
Fetch English native captions with Supadata. Validate language and content, split at 49,000 characters and upsert transcript chunks by record_id.
Record CAPTURED_AUTO and transcript_appended on success; otherwise record RETRY_LATER or NO_ENGLISH_TRANSCRIPT and attempt/error metadata.
Send one completion summary and finish the run ledger. Empty scans report nothing new; API failures explicitly report an incomplete scan.
A targeted manual_retry request bypasses discovery and processes only the validated target_video_row.

Capture does not automatically invoke analysis. Scheduled analysis, /analyse or add_video handles that next step. YouTube Data API discovers metadata; Supadata still extracts captions. A completed n8n execution can contain channel errors, so inspect the run state and Telegram summary.

Select captured videos for this event with no analysis, retryable FAILED/RETRY state, stale PROCESSING state, explicit targeted retry or CARD_CHANGED. Automatic analysis normally caps attempts at three; PROCESSING becomes stale after one hour.

Parse and validate extracted fighters, fight order, confidence, props and reasoning. When a non-bingo card of at least five bouts yields fewer than three winner picks and under 30% coverage, make one diversity retry with DeepSeek.
Build stable row identifiers and write Picks, Props, Fight Analysis and Extraction Log records; verify the configured completion signals before marking the video COMPLETED.
Record model, prompt version, token/cost information and validation outcomes; deliver the Telegram summary and finish the analysis run ledger.

Explicit manual targets can bypass the automatic attempt cap; completed videos are protected by the retry service. Verify All Writes checks picks, props and extraction_log signals; it is not a transaction or a complete read-back audit of every spreadsheet cell. Fight Analysis has its own upstream write path. Configured models and ceilings are snapshot settings, not a promise of current vendor pricing.

Thresholds intentionally differ from worker retry thresholds. The sweep reads the application's ledger rather than independently proving every n8n execution completed. Its retry-resolution rule infers success from no further failure, so read the recorded evidence.

This keeps giant HTML pages/transcripts out of diagnostic context. It does not execute or modify the workflow. Limits/truncation mean the summary is evidence, not a complete execution archive.

This records that a fix was made; it does not deploy a fix or verify all workflows. A recurring condition can reopen an incident.
